implementation_contract: Write tests first and observe targeted failures before implementation.
Implement fail-closed projector, independent validator and one-shot supervisor exactly to active V4+V5+V6 contracts.
Projector owns upstream metadata and selected public-shard reads; validator independently re-derives metadata lineage but opens no upstream Parquet; supervisor opens no Parquet payload.

Supervisor source must be disarmed by default with exact sentinel `REVIEWED_SOURCE_RUN_PACKET_SHA256: str | None = None` and must refuse production execution without a separately reviewed packet and exact armed hash.
Supervisor must durably mark ATTEMPT_CONSUMED before the first public shard open and self-disarm on both pass and failure.
Projector and validator expose callable pure/synthetic-test surfaces; importing any module must not touch production data or create files.
All production paths enter through verified workspace-relative packet authority; source code must not hardcode D:/Trading EA MT5 or cwd as authority.
Use strict JSON/JSONL, uppercase SHA256, stable-file identity checks, no-follow/reparse/link protections, atomic exclusive writes and no-replace publish.
Do not modify HYP006 code, plans, contracts, registry, docs, public custody, partial stage or any production output/evidence path.
Do not run the supervisor against production paths and do not open any file under h1_splitvault_002/public/DESIGN or h1_splitvault_002/sealed.
synthetic_acceptance: Focused six-file pytest suite passes with `python -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider`.
AST parse passes for all six files.

Tests cover schema rename/order/type/nullability rejection, missing/duplicate 12:00, clock mismatch, bytes/SHA mismatch, path escape/symlink/reparse/hardlink, unselected mapping, access-count mismatch, lineage self-consistency attacks, metadata mutation before/after publish, existing stage/final/evidence roots, packet/hash/sentinel mismatch, marker-before-open, atomic no-replace publish, pass/fail terminal and self-disarm.

Tests use only synthetic temporary files and monkeypatched capabilities; no production public shard, raw source, sealed payload, feature/economic artifact or production output/evidence is opened or created.
No source run packet, attempt ID, production marker, stage, output, evidence, registry row, EA source or MQL5 file is created.
handoff_required: Exact path/bytes/SHA256 for all six files.
Exact test command and pass count.
Statement that production payload opens and runtime artifacts remained zero.
Known limitations or any contract clause not implemented exactly.
